abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62, 000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
title: Does Field of Study Shape the Gender Wage Gap? The Role of Migration Background
title_zh: 研究领域是否影响性别工资差距？移民背景的作用

abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨学校选择对学业成就的影响。利用罗马尼亚相似城镇间学校数量的差异，当地学生通过考试成绩竞争入学名额，由此产生学校选择的变化。研究发现，更多学校选择导致学生按录取分数在不同学校间的分层加剧。这种分层扩大了高、低录取分数学生之间的成就差距。高分数学生能够获得更优质的教师资源和同伴效应，这是解释差距扩大的主要因素。最后，学校间通过择校机制形成的竞争并未提升平均学业成就水平。
title: School Choice, Student Sorting, and Academic Performance
title_zh: 学校选择、学生分类与学业表现

abstract: We study treatment-effect estimation using panel data. The treatment may be nonbinary, nonabsorbing, and the outcome may be affected by treatment lags. We make a parallel-trends assumption and propose event-study estimators of the effect of being exposed to a weakly higher treatment dose for ℓ periods. We also propose normalized estimators that estimate a weighted average of the effects of the current treatment and its lags. We also analyze commonly used two-way, fixed-effects regressions. Unlike our estimators, they can be biased in the presence of heterogeneous treatment effects. A local-projection version of those regressions is biased even with homogeneous effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用面板数据研究处理效应估计。处理变量可能为非二元、非吸收性，且结果可能受到处理滞后期的影响。我们基于平行趋势假设，提出事件研究估计量，用于估计暴露于弱更高处理剂量持续ℓ期的效应。同时，我们提出标准化估计量，以估计当前处理效应及其滞后效应的加权平均值。此外，我们分析了常用的双向固定效应回归模型。与我们的估计量不同，这些模型在存在异质性处理效应时可能产生偏误。即使处理效应具有同质性，这些回归的局部投影版本仍存在偏误。
title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
title_zh: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量

abstract: In 2001 a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, whereas persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 2001年，一场大规模且持续的供给冲击终结了澳大利亚的海洛因流行。我们利用毒品犯罪数据识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并考察了该冲击如何影响他们在随后八年间的死亡风险与犯罪活动。最初，过量用药减少带来的收益被药物替代及更多犯罪（包括凶杀案）所抵消。大多数不利影响随时间消散，而持续性的死亡率降低则挽救了样本中约每48人中的1条生命。我们的结果表明，即使短期效果尚不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供给仍能带来有意义的长期改善。
title: Opioid Use, Mortality Risks and Crime: Insights from a Rapid Reduction in Heroin Supply
title_zh: 阿片类药物使用、死亡风险与犯罪：海洛因供应快速减少的启示

abstract: This paper explores whether and why a maternal child penalty to earnings would emerge even without changes in employment and hours worked. Using a matched event study design, we trace monthly changes in determinants of wages (job performance, human capital accumulation, and promotions). Data come from a usefully unusual setting with required multiyear employment and detailed personnel data: the US Marine Corps. Mothers’ job performance initially declines, and gaps in promotion grow through 24 months postbirth. Fathers’ physical fitness performance drops somewhat but recovers. These patterns lead mothers to earn relatively lower wages, even absent changes in employment postbirth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了即使在就业和工作时长不变的情况下，母亲因育儿导致的收入惩罚是否会出现及其成因。通过匹配事件研究设计，我们追踪了工资决定因素（工作表现、人力资本积累和晋升）的月度变化。数据来源于一个具有特殊研究价值的场景——美国海军陆战队，该场景要求多年连续就业并提供详细人事数据。研究发现，母亲的工作表现最初出现下降，且晋升差距在产后24个月内持续扩大。父亲的身体素质表现虽有短暂下滑但随后恢复。这些模式导致母亲在产后即使就业状态未变，其相对工资水平仍有所降低。
title: Baby Bumps in the Road: The Impact of Parenthood on Job Performance, Human Capital, and Career Advancement
title_zh: 育儿路上的坎坷：为人父母对工作绩效、人力资本及职业晋升的影响

abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。
title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking
title_zh: 抗p-hacking的临界值

abstract: This paper describes how to reparametrize low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors to fit weak identification theory developed for generalized method of moments models. Some identification-robust tests, here called “plug-in” tests, require a reparametrization to distinguish weakly identified parameters from strongly identified parameters. The reparametrizations in this paper make plug-in tests available for subvector hypotheses in low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors. Simulations show that the plug-in tests are less conservative than identification-robust tests that use the original parametrization. An empirical application to a factor model of parental investments in children is included.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了如何对含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型进行重新参数化，以适配为广义矩估计模型开发的弱识别理论。部分识别稳健性检验（此处称为"插件式"检验）需要通过重新参数化来区分弱识别参数与强识别参数。本文提出的重新参数化方法使得插件式检验能够应用于含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型中的子向量假设。模拟结果表明，相较于使用原始参数化的识别稳健性检验，插件式检验的保守性更低。文中还包含一个关于父母对子女投资因子模型的实证应用案例。
title: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
title_zh: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题

abstract: Between 1883 and 1919, Andrew Carnegie funded the construction of more than 1,500 public libraries across the United States, reducing the costs of accessing knowledge for millions. We study the effect of these libraries on innovation. Patenting in recipient places increased on average by 10%–12% in the 20 years following library construction relative to a novel control group of cities that applied for but did not build libraries. We show that access to scientific knowledge and increased collaboration opportunities are possible mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 1883年至1919年间，安德鲁·卡内基在美国资助建造了超过1500座公共图书馆，降低了数百万人获取知识的成本。我们研究了这些图书馆对创新的影响。与一组申请建造但未建成图书馆的新颖对照组城市相比，受资助地区在图书馆建成后的20年间，专利数量平均增长了10%–12%。研究表明，获取科学知识的机会增加以及合作机会的增多是可能的机制。
title: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
title_zh: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响

abstract: Using Chicago police data, we train a machine learning model to predict the risk of being shot in the next 18 months. Out-of-sample accuracy is strikingly high. A central concern with using police data is “baking in” bias, or overestimating risk for groups likelier to interact with police conditional on behavior. Our predictions, however, accurately recover risk across demographic groups. Legal, ethical, and practical barriers should prevent using victimization predictions to target law enforcement. But using them to target social services could increase both the potential for interventions to reduce shootings and the available statistical power to detect those reductions.
abstract_zh: 利用芝加哥警方数据，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测未来18个月内被枪击的风险。样本外预测准确度惊人地高。使用警方数据的一个核心担忧是“固化”偏见，即在行为条件相同的情况下，高估更可能与警方互动的群体的风险。然而，我们的预测准确还原了不同人口群体的风险水平。法律、伦理及实践障碍应阻止将受害风险预测用于执法目标锁定。但将其用于社会服务目标锁定，既能提升干预措施减少枪击事件的潜力，也能增强检测此类减少效果的统计效能。
title: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
title_zh: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防

abstract: In markets with asymmetric information between sellers and buyers, feedback mechanisms are important to increase market efficiency and reduce the informational disadvantage of buyers. Feedback mechanisms might work because of self-selection of more trustworthy sellers into markets with such mechanisms or because of reputational concerns of sellers. We show in a field experiment how to disentangle self-selection from reputation effects. Based on 476 taxi rides with four different types of taxis, we find strong evidence for reputation effects but little support for self-selection effects. We discuss policy implications of our findings.
abstract_zh: 在卖方与买方信息不对称的市场中，反馈机制对于提升市场效率、减少买方信息劣势至关重要。反馈机制的有效性可能源于更值得信赖的卖方主动选择进入具备此类机制的市场（自选择效应），也可能源于卖方对声誉的考量（声誉效应）。我们通过一项实地实验，展示了如何区分自选择效应与声誉效应。基于对四种不同类型出租车进行的476次乘车实验，我们发现了支持声誉效应的有力证据，但几乎没有证据支持自选择效应。我们进一步讨论了研究结论的政策启示。
title: Disentangling Reputation from Selection Effects in Markets with Informational Asymmetries: A Field Experiment
title_zh: 信息不对称市场中声誉效应与选择效应的分离：一项田野实验

abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。
title: Urban Transit Infrastructure and Inequality
title_zh: 城市交通基础设施与不平等

abstract: We study the influence of workplace peers on a high-stakes, irreversible retirement plan choice. Midcareer U.S. military personnel choose between higher future pension payouts or an immediate bonus plus lower future payouts. With peers defined as those who have locked in their choices and personnel assignment rules ensuring that peer groups are exogenously formed, we capture the causal impact of peers. Greater peer take-up of the bonus, which is difficult to compare to the alternative plan but often extremely costly over one’s lifetime, discourages choosers from selecting the bonus. Peers have special impact within professional, race, and gender groups.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了工作场所同伴对一项高风险的、不可逆的退休计划选择的影响。美国军队中的职业生涯中期人员需要在更高的未来养老金支付与即时奖金加较低的未来支付之间做出选择。我们将同伴定义为那些已经锁定自己选择的人员，并且由于人员分配规则确保了同伴群体是外生形成的，我们捕捉到了同伴的因果影响。同伴对奖金的接受率更高——尽管这种奖金与替代计划难以比较，且通常在一生中代价极高——会抑制选择者选择奖金。同伴在职业、种族和性别群体内具有特殊影响。
title: Information Transmission in Groups: Peer Influence in High-Stakes, Irreversible Financial Decisions
title_zh: 群体中的信息传递：高风险不可逆财务决策中的同伴影响

abstract: We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1989年以来的瑞士富豪榜单构建了一个全新数据集。研究发现，60%的超级富豪为继承财富者——这一比例是美国的两倍——且顶层财富流动性显著下降。我们发现，最富有的0.01%人群的财富份额高于此前基于财富税统计数据的估算结果。同时，我们认为富豪榜单数据会导致财富不平等程度被高估。尽管富豪榜单对研究超级富豪群体具有重要价值，但我们建议谨慎使用所报告的财富数据。
title: Using Rich Lists to Study the Super-Rich and Top Wealth Inequality: Insights from Switzerland
title_zh: 利用富豪榜研究超级富豪与顶层财富不平等：来自瑞士的启示

abstract: Does monetary policy influence who becomes a homeowner? Lower-income home buyers may be more sensitive to interest rates, at least in part because they more frequently come up against binding payment-to-income ratio constraints in credit decisions. Exploiting the timing of high-frequency observations of individual mortgage rate locks around monetary policy shocks, I find that a 1 percentage point policy-induced increase in mortgage rates lowers the presence of lower-income households in the population of home buyers by 1 to 2 percentage points immediately following the shock. Effects are substantially stronger among first-time home buyers and persist for approximately one year.
abstract_zh: 货币政策是否影响谁会成为房主？低收入购房者可能对利率更为敏感，至少部分原因在于他们在信贷决策中更频繁地面临严格的偿债收入比约束。利用货币政策冲击前后个人抵押贷款利率锁定的高频观测时机，我发现政策导致的抵押贷款利率每上升1个百分点，在冲击发生后立即会使购房者群体中低收入家庭的比例下降1至2个百分点。这一效应在首次购房者中尤为显著，并持续约一年时间。
title: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
title_zh: 货币政策与购房不平等

abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavior change and voter support for pro-climate policies, yet surprisingly little is known about how to achieve these outcomes. In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而令人惊讶的是，关于如何实现这些目标的研究甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家的新义务教育法数据，估算了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，并纳入了关于政策偏好和投票支持绿党的新数据。结果表明，每增加一年教育会显著提升亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。
title: Human Capital and Climate Change
title_zh: 人力资本与气候变化

abstract: This paper reports causal evidence on how the extent of hybrid work—the number of days worked from home relative to days worked from office—affects employee attitudes and performance. Workers who spent around two days in the office each week on average self-reported greater work-life balance, more job satisfaction, and lower isolation from colleagues compared to workers who spent more or fewer days in the office. Employees in the intermediate hybrid condition received no different performance ratings compared to peers who spent more or fewer days in the office.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了关于混合办公程度（即居家办公天数与办公室办公天数的比例）如何影响员工态度与绩效的因果证据。与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的员工相比，平均每周在办公室工作约两天的员工自我报告的工作与生活平衡度更高、工作满意度更高，且与同事的隔离感更低。处于中等混合办公条件下的员工，其绩效评级与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的同事相比并无显著差异。
title: Is Hybrid Work the Best of Both Worlds? Evidence from a Field Experiment
title_zh: 混合办公模式是否两全其美？来自田野实验的证据

abstract: Women are underrepresented in patenting. In this study, we consider differential responsiveness to rejection as a contributor to the gender gap in invention. Leveraging the prosecution histories of almost one million U.S. patent applications and the quasirandom assignment of applications to examiners, we show that women are 3.6–6.9 percentage points less likely to continue in the application process following an early-stage rejection. Conditional on applying for a patent, male-female disparities in the propensity to abandon applications account for more than half of the overall gender gap in issued patents. We provide suggestive evidence that institutional support can help reduce the attrition gap.
abstract_zh: 女性在专利申请中的代表性不足。本研究将差异化的拒绝应对机制视为发明领域性别差距的一个促成因素。利用近百万份美国专利申请的审查历史以及申请案件准随机分配给审查员的机制，我们发现，在早期阶段遭遇驳回后，女性继续申请流程的可能性低3.6至6.9个百分点。在已提交专利申请的条件下，放弃申请倾向的性别差异解释了已授权专利总体性别差距的一半以上。我们提供的初步证据表明，制度性支持有助于缩小这一退出差距。
title: Attrition and the Gender Patenting Gap
title_zh: 流失率与性别专利差距

abstract: The US tax system allows taxpayers to deduct local taxes from their taxable incomes. Using school district referendum results, we employ a continuous treatment two-way fixed-effects framework to provide causal evidence of a positive relation between the demand for local public goods and the share of residents deducting local taxes. We find that a 1 percentage point decrease in the share of residents deducting property taxes reduces tax and bond referendum approval rates by approximately 0.97 percentage points. Because these federal tax deductions disproportionately benefit higher-income individuals, they potentially widen disparities in public service provision across jurisdictions.
abstract_zh: 美国税收制度允许纳税人从其应税收入中扣除地方税。利用学区公投结果，我们采用连续处理双向固定效应框架，为地方公共产品需求与居民地方税扣除比例之间的正相关关系提供了因果证据。研究发现，居民房产税扣除比例每下降1个百分点，税收和债券公投的通过率将降低约0.97个百分点。由于这些联邦税收扣除对高收入群体的惠及程度不成比例，它们可能加剧不同辖区之间公共服务供给的差距。
title: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
title_zh: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求

title: The Origin of the State: Land Productivity or Appropriability? Comment
title_zh: 国家的起源：土地生产力还是可占有性？评论

title: Tariffs and goods-market search frictions
title_zh: 关税与商品市场搜寻摩擦

title: Legal representation in disability claims
title_zh: 残疾索赔中的法律代理

title: Rate of return regulation revisited
title_zh: 回报率监管再审视

source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Singular vector autoregressions
title_zh: 奇异向量自回归

title: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique
title_zh: 英国食品标准局关于重组食源性风险监管方式的提案：分析与评述

title: Urban community-led total sanitation: opportunities, barriers and lessons from Nanded, India
title_zh: 城市社区主导的全面环境卫生：来自印度南德的机会、障碍与经验

title: Land tenure conflicts in Ghana and Zimbabwe: An institutional perspective
title_zh: 加纳与津巴布韦的土地权属冲突：制度视角

title: Feeding the accelerator: A metabolic historical analysis of the US food regime
title_zh: 喂养加速器：美国食物体制的代谢历史分析
